title: 2560. House Robber IV

examples.explanation: There are three ways to rob at least 2 houses: - Rob the houses at indices 0 and 2. Capability is max(nums[0], nums[2]) = 5. - Rob the houses at indices 0 and 3. Capability is max(nums[0], nums[3]) = 9. - Rob the houses at indices 1 and 3. Capability is max(nums[1], nums[3]) = 9. Therefore, we return min(5, 9, 9) = 5.
There are 7 ways to rob the houses. The way which leads to minimum capability is to rob the house at index 0 and 4. Return max(nums[0], nums[4]) = 2.
